rationale: Selects full 3x3 context by argmax tie-breaking, matching both parents with zero nonzero weights.
Full 3x3 context supports both patterns and the other ctx-k0 patterns; all-zero tensors are maximally sparse.
Own colour plus the row's non-background colour set matches both parents and supports all ctx-k1 patterns with one nonzero weight.
Row colour-set context learns each pattern's mappings from its demonstrations, supporting both parents and the other ctx-k1 patterns.
Own colour plus the column's non-background colour set matches both parents and supports all ctx-k2 patterns with one nonzero weight.
Column colour-set context learns each pattern's mappings from its demonstrations, supporting both parents and the other ctx-k2 patterns.
